summary: Alexandr Wang states that Meta's smaller 'Muse Glimmer' model can operate as a fully capable agent, performing planning, tool calls, self-checking of results, and failure recovery, comparable to much larger models.

practices.reason: The post claims a smaller model achieves full agentic capability (planning, tool use, self-correction) matching larger models, which would be worth evaluating for lower-cost agent deployments if the claim holds up.
practices.quote: muse glimmer can operate as a fully capable agent via planning, tool calls, checking its own results, and failure recovery.
